index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure illustrates a hybrid methodology for generating textual descriptions of policy signals, combining human expertise with Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities. The central component is a cylindrical gray database labeled 'Database of textual descriptions,' which serves as the repository for all generated or inputted textual representations of policy signals. This database is connected via bidirectional arrows to four surrounding modules, indicating dynamic interaction and contribution from multiple sources.

Three of these modules are green diamonds, representing processes driven by LLMs. The top-right diamond states 'LLM suggests text descriptions based on user query,' indicating that an LLM generates descriptive text in response to a user-provided query. The bottom-right diamond reads 'LLM provides image captions to serve as text descriptions,' showing that the LLM can also interpret visual inputs and convert them into textual descriptions suitable for inclusion in the database. The bottom-left diamond says 'LLM breaks down complex policy language into individual signals,' demonstrating the LLM’s ability to parse intricate policy documents and extract discrete, actionable signal descriptions.

The fourth module, located at the top-left, is a light blue rounded rectangle labeled 'User breaks policy down into individual descriptions of a possible target signal.' This represents the human-in-the-loop aspect, where domain experts manually decompose policy language into granular textual descriptions, which are then fed into the database. All four modules feed into the central database through beige-colored arrows, emphasizing that both human and AI contributions are aggregated into the same repository.

The overall layout is radial, with the database at the center and the four contributing modules arranged symmetrically around it—two on the left (one above, one below), and two on the right (one above, one below). The visual design uses distinct shapes and colors to differentiate between human-driven (blue rounded rectangle) and AI-driven (green diamonds) processes. The arrows are uniform in style and color, suggesting equal importance and seamless integration of inputs. The figure visually communicates a collaborative framework where LLMs and human experts jointly enrich a shared resource of textual policy descriptions.
